question: Should omitting `plugins.entries.active-memory.config.agents` intentionally activate Active Memory for every configured agent, including agents added later?
rationale: The code can implement either contract, but choosing whether omission means no targets or dynamic all-agent targeting changes existing operator behavior, model usage, and hidden session context.

options.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Preserve omission as no targets and improve setup or UI guidance so operators can deliberately select the desired agents.

options.title: Approve Inherited Targeting
options.body: Adopt configured-agent inheritance, document the upgrade impact, and require direct final-head runtime proof for omission and explicit-empty behavior.

options.title: Add Deliberate All-Agents Choice
options.body: Introduce an explicit setup or configuration representation for all configured agents instead of overloading omission.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Preserve omission as no targets and improve setup or UI guidance so operators can deliberately select the desired agents.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most strongly connects this person to the original Active Memory targeting and configuration contract.
